hardwareHubs.note: Home to Asmbly makerspace and the 25,000 square foot Texas Inventionworks at UT Austin.
Home to the 30,000 square foot TX/RX Labs hackerspace and Rice's 20,000 square foot Oshman Engineering Design Kitchen.

makerspaces.name: Asmbly Mechatronic Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Its site lists Laguna and Tormach CNC machines, large laser cutters, an electronics space and a 3D printing space.

makerspaces.name: TX/RX Labs
makerspaces.note: Nonprofit in a 30,000 square foot building with a rapid fabrication lab, electronics lab, metal shop, wood shop and machine shop.

events.name: Offshore Technology Conference
events.note: Energy industry trade show and conference held at NRG Park, running since 1969.

programs.name: Texas Inventionworks
programs.note: UT Austin engineering facility of over 25,000 square feet with electronics, additive manufacturing, wood and metal working equipment and an innovation accelerator.

programs.name: Oshman Engineering Design Kitchen
programs.note: Rice University prototyping facility with a machine shop, welding access and rapid prototyping equipment.

specialties.name: Semiconductors and electronics
specialties.note: Computers, electronics and semiconductors employ 85,000 Texans, with Texas Instruments expanding in Sherman and Samsung building a fab in Taylor.

specialties.name: Aerospace
specialties.note: Aerospace employs about 51,000 Texas advanced manufacturing workers, concentrated around SpaceX Starbase and Lockheed Martin facilities.

specialties.name: Chemicals and petroleum products
specialties.note: Chemicals were about 21 percent of state manufacturing GDP in a 2021 snapshot, with petroleum and coal products at about 14.5 percent.

support.name: Texas Manufacturing Assistance Center (TMAC)
support.note: The NIST MEP center for Texas, run by the University of Texas at Arlington, helping manufacturers with technology, supply chain, workforce and continuous improvement.
